Quantum Minds | Senior Software Engineer – LLVM/Fuzzing/Program Analysis | Contract | REMOTE (US) | Full-Time

Quantum Minds is hiring a senior engineer to support a modern analysis pipeline involving compiler tooling, program analysis, fuzzing, and automation. The work includes preparing the codebase for future open‑source release.

Nice to have: • Firmware/embedded (MMIO, HALs, rehosting) • CodeQL or other static‑analysis tooling • LLM/agent integration experience • CFG/SSA/dataflow background • Open‑source contribution experience

Remote contract role. Work directly with a team preparing a major analysis pipeline for future open‑source release.

Please send your resume + a short cover letter to: jobs@quantumminds.com

GC AI | Member of Technical Staff, Applied AI | REMOTE (US/Canada) | $180K–$430K + equity

GC AI is building an AI platform for in-house legal teams, helping lawyers draft, review, and analyze legal documents. The product is used by 1,800+ companies, including 150+ public companies and 25+ unicorns. GC AI raised a $60M Series B in November 2025 at a $555M valuation.

We’re hiring 5 engineers for the Applied AI team. This is a full-stack product engineering role with a strong AI execution layer — not an ML research or data science position.

Strong signals include founding/founding-engineer experience, meaningful startup ownership, or experience scaling products at strong engineering companies before moving into a smaller high-ownership environment.

Interested? Email mernaahmedemara13@gmail.com with the subject: GC AI – Applied AI Please include: - Your LinkedIn profile - Current location - A short description of an AI/LLM feature you personally shipped to production - GitHub / portfolio if relevant

General Intelligence Holdings | https://www.generalintelligenceholdings.com | Founding CTO | REMOTE (UK working-hour overlap preferred) | Fundraising | Salary/equity to be agreed

I'm Chris, founder of GIH. We're building an AI operating platform for established service businesses, starting with UK accountancy. Our model is to acquire businesses and deploy the software into their daily workflows, measuring its effect on time, quality and cost.

We've built version 1 of Helix, connecting accounting workflows, AI assistance, source evidence and review controls. It covers work including reconciliation, payroll, VAT and debtors. The next challenge is deployment in an operating practice, including production integrations, security and independent validation.

I'm looking for a hands-on CTO to own architecture and engineering delivery, write code, work with accountants and build the technical team. You should have shipped and operated customer-facing software, be comfortable with APIs and data systems, and have practical experience evaluating LLM/agent workflows. Previous CTO experience isn't essential; evidence of building and owning a product is.

We're currently fundraising and expect the round to close at the end of November 2026. You can join when the round closes or start earlier, depending on your availability and preference. Salary, equity and any arrangements before the round closes will be agreed directly. This is intended as a full-time technical leadership role.

Email chris@generalintelligencecapital.com with “HN CTO” in the subject, your CV/LinkedIn, something you built, your location and preferred start date.

Prophet Town LLC | Various Software Engineering Roles | US – Remote and Hybrid | English fluency required | Full-time | $140K-$264K annual total comp (multiple)

We are a people-first, boutique tech agency creating on-demand teams and software solutions for long-standing clients. These clients trust us to practice engineering excellence as though we were members of their own staff. Our leadership team is ex-Fortune 100 with software engineering backgrounds: we’re still coding. Notable recent projects include a gigantic ERP migration for Anduril, and working with Surge Labs to help develop some of the frontier LLM models from the big guys themselves (yes, seriously). This is a remote-first agency, but some projects involve onsite work.

I’m the founder and CEO, and I’m trying to do what I call “enlightened business”. I take responsibility for both staff and clients, and I look for people who approach their work with a similar sense of ownership.

We continue the hiring push we were running last month too: our current work would especially benefit from from ai-forward senior engineering expertise that can design RL benchmarks, red-team model outputs, and create rubrics to evaluate and enhance the agentic coding capabilities of various frontier models. We received 216 applications in our August posting, and issued offers to approximately 10 (still following up with a few).

Applicants must meet a high bar - I intend to have a personal relationship with every hire. In return you’ll get:

  * Flexibility and a low-bureaucracy environment

  * Clients that won’t treat the vendor like “the B Team”

  * The chance to act as a code architect, not just implement tickets

  * Exposure to a wide variety of industries and modern     challenges

  * Me as your personal champion and advocate
Feel free to submit, even if you already did in the past.

Current roles available:

Back-end, Front-end, and Full-Stack Software Engineers, Tiers 3 and 4 (Typescript/Javascript, React, NextJS; Ruby on Rails; Python; DevOps, and third-party API integrations)

Tier 3 roles are typically 5-10 years experience with $140-$180K total comp. Tier 4 roles are 11-20 years experience, $210-$264K total comp. Higher tiers exist, and we always welcome exceptional applications.

Please apply using this Google Form: https://forms.gle/tZwq7j2Ldwcas1wb7 .

Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack

We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer.

Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN

Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices.

Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices):

- Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code.

- ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. We spend tens of millions per year on compute; you own that budget.

- Research Scientist, Foundation Model: drive the model agenda - novel architectures, scaling from 10K to 1M+ samples, multimodal and causal directions. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent.

- Research Engineer, Foundation Model: same agenda from the engineering side. You design experiments, write the training and eval infra, and co-author the papers.

- ML Engineer, Backend: design and scale the backend that serves and finetunes the models. Python/FastAPI, Terraform, K8s.

- Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform: build the product end to end. TypeScript + Python, React/FastAPI/Postgres.

Also hiring: Applied Scientist, Forward Deployed ML Engineer, Research Scientist (Foundational Data Science), PhD research interns, plus GTM and ops roles.

40+ people with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Jane Street, Goldman, G-Research, CERN. Led by Frank Hutter, advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Yann LeCun. Comp competitive with top AI labs.

All roles and applications: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/prior-labs

Questions welcome in the replies here.

Ambito (ambito.io) — Founding AI Engineer / Equity Partner — Remote but Boston based only

Ambito is a CRM-connected QBR generator for B2B sales teams. The product is live, with the sales module, template engine, and CRM integrations already built.

We're looking for a founding AI engineer to make the product significantly smarter and broader. This is an equity-only role initially (10+ hrs/week), working directly with the founders and our existing technical partner.

You'll work on:

AI product features: Build a native assistant that can answer questions about customer data, surface trends, provide setup guidance, and help generate QBRs. Retrieval, tool use, structured-data queries, evals, and cost control.

Customer Success: Extend the existing framework into account reviews, renewals, and customer health.

Integrations: Harden and expand CRM/CS integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.).

Product: Make the overall experience faster, simpler, and more AI-native where it actually helps.

We're looking for someone who has shipped LLM features in production, not just demos, and is comfortable with retrieval, embeddings, tool calling, agent workflows, and evaluation. You should also be able to work across React, TypeScript, and Node (Firebase experience is a plus).

You should think like a product engineer: turn varied customer requests into simple, flexible systems and work independently. Sales tech / RevOps / CS experience is a plus. Boston/MA is a plus.

To apply: Send a short note with something you've built using AI and why this problem interests you. No cover letter. LinkedIn or contact@ambito.io.

We're building Thunderbolt (https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbolt). We're an 8-person and growing team within the ~60-person company behind Thunderbird, the open-source email client used by 20M+ people.

Thunderbolt is an open-source, cross-platform AI product built on the principle that people and organizations should be in control of their data, infrastructure, and model choices. It's moving from early development into enterprise use cases, and we need someone to own features end to end — concept through launch, adoption, and iteration — not just close tickets.

We're looking for 10+ years of engineering experience at Staff scope, hands-on AI product work (LLMs, RAG, agents, retrieval, model/provider abstraction), and comfort in ambiguity — architecture and enterprise requirements are still being defined. Bonus: self-hosted or regulated deployments, EU AI Act / GDPR / SOC 2 familiarity.

Must reside in and have work authorization for the US or Canada. No sponsorship. We read every cover letter - please make it authentic.
